Order No.05 Dated- 14.03.2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 903 of 2022, POCSO Case No.01 of 2023 instituted under Sections 376 and 307 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 and 12 of POCSO Act, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that there was no relationship between the petitioner and the victim girl except petitioner was in talking terms with her, who happens to be a major lady.
There was no development of any kind of intimacy between them, although due to differences between them, petitioner has been implicated in this case.
Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the trial of the case.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

4. Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State assisted by learned counsel for the complainant opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submits that there is direct and specific allegation against the petitioner of committing rape with the victim lady against her will and without her consent under the false pretext of solemnizing marriage.
Hence, petitioner may not be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: It appears that since the victim girl was a minor aged about 14 years, petitioner has physically exploited her under the false pretext of marriage.

Thereafter, the family members of the victim lady after attaining her majority, solemnized her marriage with another person in the year 2017 but during the Covid-19 pandemic, her husband died then she returned back to her parental home but petitioner again started putting pressure upon her for solemnizing marriage with her and also assaulted her.
On 12.03.2022, petitioner again forcibly committed rape with her.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the serious and heinous nature of offence against the petitioner showing his involvement in the commission of rape under the false pretext of marriage for which cognizance has already been taken against the petitioner by the court below, I am not inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the prayer of anticipatory bail of petitioner is rejected.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
